description:
[FREE] Read the SolvScore micro-limit ladder for one wallet.

Returns the published rungs ($10 starter, then $25 / $50 / $100 / $250 as
repayments are recorded), this wallet's current rung and limit, its recent
ladder events, and any standard-underwriting decision once it graduates.
A starter limit needs an allowlisted attestation, so a wallet with no attested
work reads as no ladder at all — that is the honest answer, not an error.
name: get_credit_ladder
title: Get Credit Ladder
